etimes, carriers mark a package as delivered a little early. Here are a few things you can check just in case:

Look around the delivery location (like a back porch or side door).
Check with any neighbors who might have accepted it for you.
Confirm the shipping address on your order confirmation was correct.

If you've checked and still can't find your package, a Sleep Specialist will need to open an investigation with the carrier. To get that started, could you please provide your order number?
